# One Early Swing, Then a Complete Hanshin Win

On August 16 at Mazda Stadium, Hanshin took control early.

In the first inning, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field. Hanshin quickly led 2–0.

But the win was not built on one swing alone.

Starter Ryoto Ihara gave Hanshin a steady base. Hiroshima found one answer, but Hanshin stayed in control. Hanshin added more runs in the seventh and eighth innings.

The early lead became a wide gap.

Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth inning, when Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run. After that, Hiroshima could not create another serious threat.

The final score was:

Hiroshima 1–8 Hanshin

It was a complete win for Hanshin, from the first big hit to the final score.
